name: Exam Mitra — AI Study Planner
description: Autonomous AI study planner for ALL Indian exams: JEE, NEET, UPSC, SSC, Banking, Railway, NDA, CTET, BPSC/State PSCs, CBSE/ICSE/BSEB/UP Board Class 10-12, and college exams (BTech, BSc, MBBS, BCom, LLB). Generates day-by-day plan, notes, flashcards, PYQ MCQs, free video lectures — in 90 seconds. English + हिन्दी + Hinglish.
